parsed.rationale: One participating record — the `ProcessInfo.ThermalState` extension at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift` in the `Wallpaper` package — sits under the `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/` directory, which is an explicit sample-app path. Per the decision rules, any record under `Examples/` or `SampleApp/` triggers a `sample-app-mirror` no-action regardless of other signals. Lifting the production `ProcessInfo.ThermalState` extension from `Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift` into shared code alongside a sample-app fixture would couple production semantics to demonstration code. The remaining members (`IntentError`, `PlaybackError`, `PlaybackState`, `PlayerState`, `StreamingAudioState`, `TimeoutError`) span three distinct packages (`Playback`, `DebugPanel`, `Intents`) with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, providing insufficient structural evidence to justify extraction independently of the restraint-marked record.
